name: Kama
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 20, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 20, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
Statistics
Cost 2 gp Weight 2 lbs.
Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x2; Range —; Type S; Special monk, trip
Category Light; Proficiency Exotic
Weapon Groups Blades, Light; Monk
Description
Similar to a sickle—and in some regions still used to reap grain—a kama is a short, curved blade attached to a simple handle, usually made of wood. It is sometimes also referred to as a kai, and is frequently used in pairs by martial artists.
